articles.title: Fargo wrestling USA championship brackets, results, Day 2 live updates
articles.summary: The 16U and Junior Freestyle National Championships are underway at the FargoDome, located on the campus of North Dakota State University in Fargo, N.D. This significant three-day wrestling tournament, which commenced on June 11, brings together the nation's top young freestyle wrestlers. Such national-level sporting events highlight the importance of physical fitness and competitive spirit, traits crucial for defence aspirants.

articles.title: The Sun ejects roughly a billion tons of charged plasma in a single coronal mass ejection — and it can cross 150 million kilometers to Earth in under 18 hours
articles.summary: A Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) is a powerful solar event where the Sun expels a massive piece of itself into the solar system. This involves roughly a billion tons of magnetised plasma, which is torn loose from the Sun's corona and launched at extremely high speeds. CMEs represent significant releases of solar material, impacting the broader space environment.

articles.title: Networking and the Internet, from First Principles
articles.summary: This article likely explores the incredible technology behind instant global communication, such as texting, calls, and video chats across continents. It delves into how replies arrive almost instantaneously, making distant interactions feel local. Understanding these underlying mechanisms is crucial in today's interconnected world, showcasing the marvel of modern telecommunications infrastructure.

articles.title: Indian Navy protected ₹9,000 cr cargo during West Asia crisis, says Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh lauded the Indian Navy's critical role during the West Asia crisis, successfully safeguarding 19 cargo vessels. He emphasized that this demonstrated the Navy's evolution into a robust guardian of India's financial stability and maritime trade. The operations highlighted the Navy's strategic importance in ensuring safe passage and contributing to national economic resilience amidst regional tensions.

articles.title: Rajnath commissions 'INS Mahendragiri' into Navy, says indigenous stealth warship will 'extend India's blue-water reach, consolidate presence in IOR'
articles.summary: INS Mahendragiri, an advanced stealth frigate, has been commissioned into the Indian Navy, marking a significant stride in indigenous defence capabilities. This warship underscores India's growing self-reliance and design prowess in military technology. Equipped with advanced weaponry, it enhances the Navy's operational readiness and ability to undertake diverse maritime operations, strengthening national security and naval power projection.

articles.title: Where to watch 2026 MLB Draft, TV, live stream, time; Brewers' picks
articles.summary: The highly anticipated 2026 Major League Baseball (MLB) Draft is scheduled for Saturday, July 11, and Sunday, July 12. This event marks a crucial step for the next generation of baseball talent, as aspiring athletes prepare to hear their names called and begin their professional journeys towards the big leagues, signifying a fresh influx of players into top-tier American baseball.

articles.title: PM Modi leaves for home after concluding visit to New Zealand
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a two-day visit to New Zealand, elevating bilateral ties to a strategic partnership. This significant development strengthens cooperation between the two nations across various sectors. The visit highlighted India's growing diplomatic engagement in the Indo-Pacific region, fostering deeper political, economic, and security relations with key partners like New Zealand, demonstrating India's active foreign policy.

articles.title: As India-New Zealand ramp up ties, Congress recalls ex-Kiwi PM David Lange reviving relations in 1984
articles.summary: India and New Zealand officially elevated their bilateral relationship to a strategic partnership on Saturday. This significant diplomatic development signals a new era of cooperation between the two nations. The move also prompted discussions recalling former Kiwi Prime Minister David Lange's previous efforts to revise and strengthen bilateral ties, highlighting the historical context behind this important advancement in international relations.

articles.title: "Indian Navy not just a fighting force, but strong guardian of India's economic interests": Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized the Indian Navy's critical role, stating recent global events underscore the need for a highly capable and responsive naval force. He highlighted its importance in safeguarding national interests, ensuring maritime security, and contributing to regional stability. This reiterates India's commitment to strengthening its naval power for strategic influence.

articles.title: Lens data import: all done bar the shouting
